findings.title: Inline hex color literals used instead of theme tokens
findings.rule_text: No inline hex color literals in components; use theme tokens from `theme.ts`.
findings.issue: The button component uses hardcoded hex color values #3b82f6 and #ffffff directly in the style prop instead of referencing theme tokens.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace inline hex colors with theme tokens from theme.ts.
findings.fix_example:
const buttonStyle = { background: theme.colors.primary, color: theme.colors.text };
return <button style={buttonStyle}>{label}</button>;
